snippet.title: Tiny Bookshop Mobile Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
That's right! Tiny Bookshop is finally coming to mobile on July 9th!  

We are super excited to bring Tiny Bookshop to mobile, and we hope you're looking forward for this release! 

You can now wishlist, pre-order, and pre-register on the App Store and Google Play Store today, and get ready to play Tiny Bookshop on the go, wherever you are! 

- Google Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.neoludic.tbs
- Apple App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6766267906
- Official Website: https://tinybookshopgame.com/
- Join our Discord server! → https://discord.gg/ze68EfD6q
